entry.title: Token bucket rate limiting
entry.summary: How a token bucket admits bursts but enforces an average rate — with a live simulation, implementations, and the mistakes that bite in production.

entry.title: Pedagogical writing: so the reader could have invented it
entry.summary: A clear, correct explanation can teach almost nothing. Pedagogical writing orders an idea so the reader could have invented it: a need, a naive attempt, its crack, then the fix and its name.

entry.title: How a DEFLATE block sends its own code
entry.summary: A Huffman code fitted to the data pays only if the decoder can be told it cheaply. Four tries take the description from 1,264 bits to 159, by sending code lengths and nothing else.

entry.title: How DEFLATE compresses
entry.summary: DEFLATE, inside gzip, zlib, PNG and ZIP, makes two separate savings: LZ77 removes repetition, then Huffman coding removes skew. Built up from one 35-byte string, down to the last bit.

entry.title: How DEFLATE works
entry.summary: DEFLATE, the format inside gzip, zlib, PNG and ZIP, is two ideas stacked: LZ77 removes repetition, then Huffman coding removes skew. Here is each, step by step.

entry.title: Announcing patchcov
entry.summary: Patch coverage for git diffs, as a command and a GitHub Action: a precise, gateable answer to what a change left untested, with no service in the loop.
